records.text: On April 14, 2024, during Iran and Hezbollah's retaliation for Israel's bombing of the Iranian embassy in Damascus, the Egyptian aircraft SU-BTU flew from Cairo to Paris and stayed there for six days.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Similarly, on April 14th of 2024—I believe I wrote 25, but I think it's 24—there was Operation True Promise, okay? ... That's when Israel was being bombed by Iran and Hezbollah in retaliation because Israel had bombed the Iranian embassy in Damascus. ... Well, lo and behold, that same Egyptian plane took off, flew from Cairo, always to Paris, and it stayed there for six days.

verification.notes: No authoritative public historical flight record located establishes SU-BTU flying Cairo to Paris on April 14, 2024 or remaining there six days. Current flight-tracking pages do not expose sufficient historical detail. Audited public-record limitation; verification was attempted.
